newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cuts taxes in reforms packages.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cuts taxes in reforms packages.

text.p: Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif's government on Friday unveiled an economc reforms package on Friday, cutting taxes.

The package, announced by Finance Minister Sartaj Aziz, included cuts in the maximum import tariff to 45 percent from the existing 65 percent, except for automobiles, and in general sales tax and personal income tax.
Aziz proposed the imposition of a three percent general sales tax (GST) at the retail level from July 1, initially in large cities, including the capital Islamabad.
He said details of the tax would be discussed with traders, but the sale of food items and medicines would be exempt.
Aziz said the package would form the basis for proposed negotiations with the International Monetary Fund (IMF) for an Extended Structural Adjustment Fund loan.
